review: candidate — promote to its strongest durable form: script fix > lint rule > guide prose. Bar: seen in ≥2 independent runs, verified against ground truth, or reviewer judgment. Contradicted → mark deprecated here (with evidence), don't delete.

learnings.statement: In strictly-primitives, an @mention autocomplete picker can be composed from useContactList() + your own dropdown state/UI without Velt's VeltAutocomplete, and measures pixel-clean against the design.
learnings.evidence: Loop 2 privado: 6/6 buildable blocks delta-clean, gate PASS exit 0

learnings.component: custom dropdown composed from useContactList + own state

learnings.statement: delta-compare coverage-floor isRepeating regex (/comment|thread|list|feed/ on familyId+component) treats composer sub-row family 'fam-comment-input-mention' as a list surface, so EVERY composer-row block requires a passing compareGap even though it is not a list — author an adjacent 0px (row-to-row) or checkbox-to-label gap.
learnings.evidence: gate INCOMPLETE until a gap was added to assign-row/body blocks; familyId contained 'comment'

learnings.statement: For a custom autocomplete/search dropdown sourced from live data, cap visible rows to the design frame's row count (6 default / 3 search here) so the panel height is content-independent and matches the frame; Velt itself virtual-scrolls past ~6.
learnings.evidence: search-content gross content-height 246 vs 142 until results capped to 3

learnings.statement: A frontend-only run (Django/host backend intentionally not started) produces pre-existing host-app console errors (ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED to its own backend, 'Failed to fetch' in saveUserToDatabase). These are environmental, not customization defects — add them to smoke allowedConsoleErrorPatterns.
A design node set visible:false (hidden) is NOT an SDK gap — it is design intent to omit that surface. Verify via Figma REST and account the block GAP with the REST evidence, not mode_blocked.
learnings.evidence: both Mention Dropdown Footer instances (I175:7816/7817;7901:13314) are visible:false
